title: Care Desk Guidance on Kestrel's Cure Handling Clock for Title & Registration Services Orders
content:
On a Title & Registration Services order, Kestrel's cure handling clock is the date from which Kestrel's own handling time is measured when a fee shortage is cured. Kestrel's cure handling clock starts on the date an outside lender's proceeds were posted to the purchase order when an outside lender's proceeds were posted and the latest posting came after the order's latest document; it starts on the vehicle's handover date when the handover came after the order's latest document and no outside lender's proceeds were posted after that document; otherwise it starts on the date the order's latest document was received.

## Records read

- The payment entries on the purchase order ledger under Vehicle Purchase Agreements whose source is outside lender proceeds, and the date of the latest of them.
- The handover date on that purchase order.
- The date of the latest document entry received on the title order.

## Decision table

| Latest outside-lender proceeds posting | Handover date | Clock starts on |
|---|---|---|
| posted, and the latest posting is after the latest document | any | the latest outside-lender posting date |
| none posted, or the latest posting is on or before the latest document | after the latest document | the handover date |
| none posted, or the latest posting is on or before the latest document | on or before the latest document | the date the latest document was received |

## Hypothetical illustrations

- Latest document received 12 July; outside lender proceeds posted 20 July; handover 15 July. The clock starts 20 July.
- Latest document received 12 July; outside lender proceeds posted 8 July only; handover 15 July. The clock starts 15 July.
- Latest document received 12 July; no outside lender proceeds; handover 10 July. The clock starts 12 July.
- A posting on the same day as the latest document is not after it, so it does not start the clock.
